title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: Ten documented CSUSM study environments, from quiet reading space and reservable rooms to computer-equipped and tutoring-adjacent work areas.

cards.title: Settle Into the Fifth-Floor Reading Room
cards.subtitle: A designated quiet room inside Kellogg Library
cards.notes: Bring quiet, individual work to KEL 5400 and check the library schedule first, since student study access follows building hours.
cards.short_summary: A fifth-floor room expressly designated for quiet student study.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUSM identifies KEL 5400 on the fifth floor as a quiet study space available to all students during University Library open hours.
cards.source_title: Featured study spot: 5th floor reading room
cards.access_notes: Open to all students during University Library building hours; the room may occasionally host an authorized event.

cards.title: Build a Working Session on the Second Floor
cards.subtitle: Reservable rooms for small CSUSM student groups
cards.notes: Reserve within the 24-hour booking window, arrive with at least one partner, and use the room's whiteboard and outlets to organize the session.
cards.short_summary: Bookable group rooms suited to collaborative work with basic presentation surfaces and power.
cards.evidence_claim: The library places group study rooms on its second floor; rooms have tables, chairs, whiteboards, and power outlets and require advance reservations.
cards.access_notes: Current CSUSM students only; groups must include at least two students. Reserve no more than 24 hours in advance.

cards.title: Take Group Work to the Fourth Floor
cards.subtitle: Advance-reservation rooms inside Kellogg Library
cards.notes: Check the scheduler the day before, gather a group of two or more, and bring markers if you plan to map ideas on the supplied whiteboard.
cards.short_summary: A fourth-floor cluster of enclosed rooms for scheduled academic collaboration.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUSM lists group study rooms on the fourth floor, generally seating four to twelve people and providing tables, chairs, whiteboards, and outlets.
cards.access_notes: Restricted to current CSUSM student academic use by groups of at least two; reservations open 24 hours ahead.

cards.title: Put the Fifth-Floor Displays to Work
cards.subtitle: Technology-equipped rooms for collaborative projects
cards.notes: Book up to two weeks ahead and carry the right HDMI adapter or confirm wireless compatibility before planning a screen-based group review.
cards.short_summary: Reservable collaboration rooms distinguished by widescreen digital displays.
cards.evidence_claim: Fifth-floor group study rooms add widescreen digital displays with HDMI or wireless connections to the standard room furnishings.
cards.access_notes: For current CSUSM student groups of two or more; advance reservations may be made up to two weeks ahead.

cards.title: Reserve a Room for Solo Online Work
cards.subtitle: Four third-floor rooms intended for individual study
cards.notes: Use the room scheduler within the 24-hour window and choose this option when a remote class or video meeting calls for an individual room.
cards.short_summary: Four reservable rooms that allow a single student to study or join online coursework.
cards.evidence_claim: The University Library provides four Zoom Rooms on its third floor for individual study by CSUSM students.
cards.access_notes: Current CSUSM students may reserve a Zoom Room for individual study; reservations open 24 hours in advance.

cards.title: Plug In at the Technology Learning Center
cards.subtitle: An open computer lab with flexible work areas
cards.notes: Choose a Mac or Windows station, reposition the study buoys for collaboration, or use a sit-stand station when you need an adjustable setup.
cards.short_summary: A computer-rich workspace offering ergonomic seating, power, charging, and private study pods.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUSM describes KEL 2000 as its main open computer lab, with Mac and Windows computers, collaboration space, powered tables, study pods, and sit-stand stations.
cards.access_notes: Located in KEL 2000; consult current Kellogg Library and IITS schedules before visiting.

cards.title: Match the Furniture to the Assignment
cards.subtitle: Third-floor pods, group areas, computers, and Zoom rooms
cards.notes: Use a pod for focused work or shift to group seating for collaboration; bring a charger if you expect to use the space for an extended session.
cards.short_summary: A flexible third-floor lab supporting both private concentration and collaborative work.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUSM reports that the Hybrid Learning Lab contains individual study pods, group study spaces, an upgraded computer lab, Zoom rooms, and comfortable furniture.
cards.source_title: At Age 20, Kellogg Library Keeps Reinventing Itself to Serve Students
cards.access_notes: Located on Kellogg Library's third floor; access follows current library building rules and hours.

cards.title: Spread Out in The Makery Game Room
cards.subtitle: A second-floor room with tables, chairs, and board games
cards.notes: Sign in on arrival, use the tables for a project or study break, and verify The Makery's operating hours before heading to the second-floor wing.
cards.short_summary: A named room within The Makery that pairs table seating with low-tech recreation.
cards.evidence_claim: The Makery's official information states that its game room provides board games, tables, and chairs for visitors to use.
cards.access_notes: CSUSM students, faculty, and staff may enter during The Makery's operating hours after completing the required sign-in form.

cards.title: Work Near Academic Support
cards.subtitle: A communal space with rooms for individual and group study
cards.notes: Set up in the communal area or ask about an available study room, keeping tutoring and coaching activity in mind when choosing your workspace.
cards.short_summary: An academic-support setting designed with both open seating and enclosed study rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUSM documented the Academic Success Center as open to all students for individual and group study, with a communal area and six monitor-equipped study rooms.
cards.source_title: Coaching Students to the Academic Finish Line
cards.access_notes: The center later moved to Level 2 of the Extended Learning Building; verify current center hours and room availability before visiting.

cards.title: Study Beside Drop-In STEM Help
cards.subtitle: A Level 2 academic-support center in the Extended Learning Building
cards.notes: Bring a STEM assignment for independent work, then use drop-in tutoring when a question stalls you; check the current service schedule before arriving.
cards.short_summary: A study-friendly support center where students can work near tutors and academic resources.
cards.evidence_claim: CSUSM's academic-support guide invites students to spend time studying at the STEM Success Center and lists drop-in tutoring, laptops, textbooks, and study resources.
cards.access_notes: Located with CLASS on Level 2 of the Extended Learning Building; consult the center's current tutoring and building schedule.
